name: Ultimate Sandbox
author: Tariq Almheiri
wuhan6910
description: A native-style creative toolbox for Balatro. Add any Joker, consumable, Voucher, tag, or custom playing card to a live run; batch-edit deck cards; browse tags as native icons with hover descriptions; delete deck cards or Jokers; duplicate owned cards; and edit poker-hand levels, hands, discards, hand-size limit, and money.
